name: Rainy Summer
source:
This summer it rains all the time and you are bored by sitting home all the time. But what can you do, when your parents didn't get vacation and so you won't be able to go anywhere this year. It looks like this summer will be no good... 

Rainy Summer is a short, romantic and kinetic (no choices, one ending) visual novel.

[From [URL=http://lunaen.com/games/rainy_summer]official site[/URL]]
translation:
今年夏天一直在下雨，你整天坐在家里无聊透了。但父母没休假，今年你哪里也去不了。看来这个夏天要泡汤了……

《雨季之夏》是一部短小、浪漫且线性（无选项、单一结局）的视觉小说。

[来自[URL=http://lunaen.com/games/rainy_summer]官网[/URL]]
